run_ttyplay2_cli: run ttyplay2 to replay an NLE NetHack terminal recording with NLE action labels
run_ttyplay2_no_wait: run ttyplay2 with --no_wait to replay a tty recording at maximum speed without delays
run_ttyplay2_peek: run ttyplay2 in peek mode to tail a live tty recording file in real time
run_ttyplay2_speed: run ttyplay2 with a custom speed multiplier to control playback speed of a tty recording
run_ttyplay2_print_inputs: run ttyplay2 with --print_inputs to display NLE action names alongside terminal output
